pairs.english: Salt and sugar had changed the fruit: unlike the mouth-puckering one on the mountain path, yet sour enough to make him want another.

pairs.english: Remembering Luodi's expression, Tavi decided not to tell him yet that he had found the tasty version.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起罗荻那副样子，决定暂时不告诉他自己找到了好吃的。

pairs.target: huí kèzhàn , zhǎngguì jiào tā qù kàn xìn .

pairs.english: Mira said she had not replied “I know,” because she really had filled half a shoe while trying it, and Guji had not hidden that for her.

pairs.hanzi: 伊文收到的是旧弧和扣件那页，先问帮着推销的人叫什么，别写成“一个没上过白阶的人”，自己隔那么远也能看出这句像在给人发奖状。

pairs.target: tā gēn shī nán qù le yíchù zhuāngxiè chǎng , běnlái zhǐyào duì qīng jiāojiē shíchén , zuìhòu tīng le bànrì shuí gāi chū diàn lún de qián .
pairs.english: He had gone with Shinan to a loading yard, originally just to check handover times, but ended up hearing half a day about who should pay for wheel pads.
pairs.hanzi: 他跟施南去了一处装卸场，本来只要对清交接时辰，最后听了半日谁该出垫轮的钱。

pairs.english: The yard people said carts damaged the road; owners said access fees already covered maintenance. But the old slip said only “yard fee,” letting everyone stuff their preferred half of the meaning inside.
pairs.hanzi: 场地的人说车坏了路，车主说出入钱里已经算了养路，旧单子却只写“场费”，谁都能把自己想要的半边塞进去。

pairs.english: Iven said his father made it sound clear around a table; standing in mud, his own first thought was when his shoes would dry.

pairs.english: A small line at the end said, if the sour fruit was already sent, not to fob him off with something Tavi had never eaten himself.

pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿起罐子看了看，忽然觉得这一罐还是有些小。

pairs.english: His master told him not to dismantle it immediately, but try once more and see if he could turn the fault into a joke onstage.

pairs.target: nài lěi de xìn bù cháng . tā cóng xībiān yíduàn pōlù huílái , bǐ yuánlái yùxiǎng duō zhù le liǎngyè ,
pairs.english: Nerai's letter was brief. She had returned from a western hillside road, staying two nights longer than planned,
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾的信不长。她从西边一段坡路回来，比原来预想多住了两夜，

pairs.target: yīnwèi jièzhù rénjiā de háizi fārè , tóngháng de rén tì nà jiā qù zhènshàng qǐng le yīgōng , děng rén jiēshǒu cái líkāi .
pairs.english: because a child in the household lodging them had a fever. A companion fetched a medical worker from town; they left only after someone took over.

pairs.target: tā méi bǎ zhè xiěchéng jīngxiǎn shì , hòutou biàn jiēzhe mà nà dìfāng de chuáng tuǐ , bànyè fānshēn zǒng pèng xīgài .
pairs.english: She did not make it an adventure tale, moving straight on to complain about the bed legs that knocked her knees whenever she turned at night.
pairs.hanzi: 她没把这写成惊险事，后头便接着骂那地方的床腿，半夜翻身总碰膝盖。

pairs.english: She asked how work was going and whether his first academy review date was set; if she could make it, she wanted to hear about it, otherwise she would leave a letter.

pairs.english: Looking at the letter's date, Tavi remembered he had not yet written to her about Zhetong.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着信头的日期，才想起自己还没给她写过折桐的见闻。

pairs.target: nà jǐzhāng shuō dēngé de zhǐ jìgěi le sè lā hé péngyǒu , tā zìrán hái bù zhīdào jiù hú .

pairs.target: tā pūkāi zhǐ , xiān gěi yīwén xiě luó dí hé yù hé de míngzì , fēnqīng shuí bāng le nǎ yìhuí .
pairs.english: He spread out paper and first wrote Luodi's and Yuhe's names for Iven, distinguishing who had helped on which occasion.

pairs.english: He added a moth sketch for Mira but did not believe it himself when finished, so wrote that the leaf beside it was real and she must guess the insect again.

pairs.target: gěi pà wò xiě zìjǐ hái huì yòng nà zhī xiàn tǒng , bié ná qù gěi láng ān yǎnjīng .
pairs.english: To Pavo he wrote that he still needed the thread spool, not to turn it into the wolf's eye.
pairs.hanzi: 给帕沃写自己还会用那只线筒，别拿去给狼安眼睛。

pairs.target: xiěgěi nài lěi shí , tā mànxiàlái , jiāng hòu xíng wū , chāi qù de jiē láng hé méi zhǎodào de zǒngtú gè shuō qīng , chāo shàng péi lǎorén gěi de jiù dàng hào , yòu wèn tā yǒuméiyǒu tīng guò nàtiáo xī wā zhuǎn xiàn .
pairs.english: Writing to Nerai, he slowed down, explaining the waiting house, removed gallery and missing overall plan separately, copying Old Pei's archive numbers and asking if she had heard of the West Hollow transfer route.
pairs.hanzi: 写给奈蕾时，他慢下来，将候行屋、拆去的接廊和没找到的总图各说清，抄上裴老人给的旧档号，又问她有没有听过那条西洼转线。

pairs.target: búshì qǐng tā lìkè qù zhǎo , zhǐshì hěn xiǎng zhīdào nà yìtóu shìfǒu céng yǒurén zǒu huílái .
pairs.english: He was not asking her to search at once; he just wanted to know whether anyone had ever walked back from the other end.
pairs.hanzi: 不是请她立刻去找，只是很想知道那一头是否曾有人走回来。

pairs.target: jǐfēngxìn dōu fàngjìn dài jì lán , fù guò dài jì de qián , guǒ guàn què liúzài zhuōshàng , dé děng zhǎngguì míngrì zhǎo héshì de kuāng zhuāng .

pairs.english: Tavi watched a while, lifted the outer lid and sniffed, but finally left the spoon untouched. He took Iven's page out again and added that he had already tasted it; if Iven found it sour, he could only blame his own tongue.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了一会儿，揭开外盖闻了闻，最后没动勺子，将给伊文的纸又抽出来，多添一句：已经尝过了，若嫌酸，也只能怪他自己的舌头。
